### Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal: > 70% enzyme activity** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days or TQ (300mg) | Implemented | Side effect monitoring at the health centre | Partial implementation |
| **Intermediate: females 30-70% enzyme activity** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Implemented | Side effect monitoring at the health centre | Partial implementation |
| **G6PD deficient: < 30% enzyme activity** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Implemented | Side effect monitoring at the health centre | Partial implementation |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Implemented | Side effect monitoring at the health centre | Partial implementation |
